analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 trading days maintained a wait-and-see approach. RSI continues to consolidate in the neutral zone, and MACD histogram shows persistent weakness. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low ($80,642.59) above the 20-day low ($80,336.91), signaling a recovery. Trading volume ratio of 1.87 indicates a surge, adding momentum to the price action. The current price ($81,119.69) is consolidating between SMA50 ($81,155.86) and the Bollinger Band middle line ($83,779.22). Weekly ADX at 26.7 suggests a clear trend, but daily MACD weakness and RSI neutral consolidation indicate a lack of directional conviction. The price is at 39.9% of its 52-week range, in a rebound phase from the lows.
